_comment: DRAFT (O-3): every entry from cottage_key down was written for W8-H (docs/WORLD_PLAN.md section 2) and is pending the owner's sign-off on voice and facts. Each has exactly one source in the Vale (tests/test_houses.gd audits it). kinds: kindling, fragment, key, tool (weapons carry slot 'weapon'), lore (written things), keepsake (objects that tell a life). The pond shrine's verse hides a syllable in its capitals; which syllable is the owner's call and should match the crypt's.

kindling_grey.name: Grey Kindling
kindling_grey.lore: Ash-coloured wood that has forgotten how to burn. The Hearth will remember for it.

kindling_green.name: Green Kindling
kindling_green.lore: Still sap-wet, cut from a tree that never asked to die. It will hiss before it catches.

kindling_red.name: Red Kindling
kindling_red.lore: Stained dark at one end. Whatever it was pulled from, it was not a tree.

sluice_wheel.name: Sluice Wheel
sluice_wheel.lore: Rusted iron, heavier than it looks. Someone drained the pond on purpose.

storm_lantern.name: Storm Lantern
storm_lantern.lore: Its glass is cracked and its flame leans toward Hollowmere's low places, as if listening.

bell_rope.name: Bell Rope
bell_rope.lore: Frayed hemp from the chapel tower. The bell has not rung since the water left.

castle_key.name: Castle Key
castle_key.lore: Cold even in a warm hand. The lord of Hollowmere locked his gate from the inside.

name_fragment_crypt.name: Name Fragment (Crypt)
name_fragment_crypt.lore: A syllable scratched into a coffin lid. The dead kept what the living let go.

name_fragment_shrine.name: Name Fragment (Shrine)
name_fragment_shrine.lore: Pressed into cold wax at a candle shrine. The Wick left it here and kept walking.

name_fragment_windmill.name: Name Fragment (Windmill)
name_fragment_windmill.lore: Carved into a sail that no longer turns. The wind in Hollowmere has nothing left to say.

torch.name: Torch
torch.lore: A borrowed flame. It burns a little faster the closer you carry it to the drained pond.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.lore: Its head is pitted from striking things that were not nails. Walls, mostly. Some bone.

sword.name: Sword
sword.lore: Notched and honest. Whoever carried it before you did not come back for it.

cottage_key.name: Cottage Key
cottage_key.lore: Iron, small, on a loop of frayed blue thread. Somebody locked a door on the west road and carried the key as far as the farms before they stopped carrying anything.

watch_key.name: Watch Key
watch_key.lore: Stamped with the castle's mark and left on an altar, as if the toll-man had asked a shrine to keep his chest shut for him. It did.

unsent_letter.name: Letter Never Sent
unsent_letter.lore: 'Tam, Bram, come home before the fire goes. There is still bread.' The ink ran before the words did. It was folded and never left the house.

bell_ringers_hymnal.name: Bell-Ringer's Hymnal
bell_ringers_hymnal.lore: The order of the bells is written here and it is wrong: three strokes crossed out and the right ones never added. He hummed it that way to the end.

toll_ledger.name: Toll Ledger
toll_ledger.lore: The last line, in a hurrying hand: three carts east, toward where the sun scars the ground. One iron wheel, sluice-sized, under sacking. No toll taken.

siege_tally.name: Siege Tally Stick
siege_tally.lore: Forty-one notches, then one deep cut across them all. The siege ended when there was nobody left inside to besiege.

maren_spade.name: Gravekeeper's Spade
maren_spade.lore: Worn to a shine where her hands went. Every grave by the pond is the same depth; she measured them against herself.

hearth_ash.name: Cold Hearth Ash
hearth_ash.lore: Grey and fine, and faintly warm if you hold it long enough. Every hearth in the Vale was lit from the one under the pond, and every one is going out.

pell_fish.name: Carved Fish
pell_fish.lore: A child's knife made this. Its mouth is open, as if to say that something warm lives under the water.

candle_stub.name: Candle Stub
candle_stub.lore: Pressed with a thumbprint too small to be a grown hand. Somebody still lights the shrine candles, and nobody told her what for.

cracked_mirror.name: Cracked Hand-Mirror
cracked_mirror.lore: It shows the room behind you a little greyer than it is. The pond does the same, and nobody looks into it for long.

dog_collar.name: Stray Dog's Collar
dog_collar.lore: A name scratched off and another scratched on. The dogs stopped waiting at the doors; this one stopped first.

rust_sickle.name: Rusted Sickle
rust_sickle.lore: The last harvest was cut with this and left lying in the field. Nobody came to carry it in.

orchard_apple.name: Orchard Apple
orchard_apple.lore: Picked the last autumn the trees bore. It has not rotted. Nothing in Hollowmere finishes.

pruning_hook.name: Pruning Hook
pruning_hook.lore: Kept sharp for trees that stopped growing. Cutting dead wood from dead wood is a habit, not a hope.

shepherd_crook.name: Shepherd's Crook
shepherd_crook.lore: The flock went strange and walked up into the hills. He followed them up and did not follow them down.

watchmans_horn.name: Watchman's Horn
watchmans_horn.lore: Cracked along its length. It was blown on the last day, and the sound went down the valley and found nobody.

oath_ribbon.name: Oath Ribbon
oath_ribbon.lore: Blue, once. A knight ties it to his helm the day he swears and cuts it the day he fails. This one was cut, and kept.

woodcutter_wedge.name: Woodcutter's Wedge
woodcutter_wedge.lore: Iron, for splitting. The trees in the east wood stopped falling cleanly; they lean away from the axe now.

pilgrim_token.name: Pilgrim's Token
pilgrim_token.lore: A wax seal stamped with a wick. The Pilgrim leaves one wherever he sleeps, so that somebody will know he passed.

travellers_cloak.name: Traveller's Cloak
travellers_cloak.lore: Heavy wool, rubbed thin at the shoulder where a pack strap sat. Someone walked a long way in this.

leather_coat.name: Leather Coat
leather_coat.lore: Oiled against a rain that stopped years ago. The collar still stands up on its own.

hunters_mantle.name: Hunter's Mantle
hunters_mantle.lore: Short, green, cut to keep a bowstring clear. The Vale had hunters before it had mourners.

ashen_shroud.name: Ashen Shroud
ashen_shroud.lore: Grave cloth, and too long for you. The Vale buried its dead in good linen while it still had some.

spear.name: Spear
spear.lore: A boar spear with a cross-bar below the head, so what you stop stays stopped at arm's length.
